scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck
scripts.deadcode: pnpm --filter @pidex/api build && pnpm --filter @pidex/web exec svelte-kit sync && knip
scripts.pretest: pnpm --filter @pidex/api build && pnpm --filter @pidex/web exec svelte-kit sync
scripts.prototype:terminal: prototype_state_dir=$(node -p "require('node:fs').mkdtempSync(require('node:path').join(require('node:os').tmpdir(), 'pidex-terminal-'))") && trap 'rm -rf "$prototype_state_dir"' EXIT && VITE_TERMINAL_PROTOTYPE=1 pnpm build && PIDEX_TERMINAL_PROTOTYPE=1 PIDEX_STATE_DIR=$prototype_state_dir PORT=4873 pnpm --filter @pidex/desktop start
